name: Due Diligence — "other than enchanted creature" leaves out only the creature it is on
notes: Memory: project_audit_vocabulary_that_player_defending_player_2026-10-19. 'When this Aura enters, target creature you control other than enchanted creature gets +2/+2' listed nothing (the words became a required subtype). The words are cut from the filter and the creature the Aura is on as the ability fires is kept out (_addAbilityPseudo, otherThanAttached).
